records_captured: one high-resolution Pokémon HOME render per form that has a Champions menu sprite

fields.name: form_name
fields.description: The form's own PokéAPI slug, matching data/staging/pokeapi.schema.json's form_name and resolving directly to pokemon_key

fields.name: pokeapi_resource_id
fields.description: The form's own PokéAPI resource id (e.g. 10034 for charizard-mega-x), not the species National Dex number; this is what the sprite repository's file names are keyed by

fields.name: image_kind
fields.description: Constant: home_render. Distinguishes these rows from Bulbagarden's menu_sprite rows in the shared pokemon_asset entity

fields.name: local_cache_path
fields.description: File name under data/assets/pokeapi_artwork/ where the downloaded bytes were cached

fields.name: sha1
fields.description: SHA-1 of the downloaded image bytes, computed locally (the sprite repository publishes no checksum to compare against)

fields.name: width
fields.description: Image width in pixels, read from the PNG IHDR chunk (512 for HOME renders)

fields.name: height
fields.description: Image height in pixels, read from the PNG IHDR chunk (512 for HOME renders)

fields.name: mime_type
fields.description: Constant: image/png. Recorded rather than assumed so a non-PNG response is visible as a contract violation

fields.name: file_size_bytes
fields.description: Size of the downloaded image in bytes

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Full raw.githubusercontent.com URL the image was downloaded from

fields.name: source_record_id
fields.description: Upstream PokéAPI resource id, equal to pokeapi_resource_id

fields.name: dataset_version
fields.description: Dataset version this staging snapshot feeds

known_risks: Not every PokéAPI form has a published HOME render: alternate forms added late, and cosmetic-only forms, can 404. A missing render is skipped rather than fabricated, so the gap shows up as a coverage-gate number (docs/dataset-spec.md's home_render coverage gate) rather than as a failed run.

The sprite repository publishes no checksum, so unlike the Bulbagarden extractor there is no upstream sha1 to re-verify a cached file against; a cached file is trusted on presence and its digest recorded from the local bytes.

Artwork is Nintendo/Game Freak-owned. It is redistributed in release packages under the same known-limitation disclaimer as the Bulbagarden sprites (see releases/data/README.md), not under a cleared right.
